name: Yorktown Summer Day Camp
description_short: Town day camp for grades K to 5, June 30 to July 31, 2026. Full day camp (grades 1 to 5, 8:30 to 3) at Crompond Elementary has sports, arts and crafts, nature and free swim at the Shrub Oak or Junior Lake pools, with after care to 6; half day camp (K to 5, 8:30 to noon) meets at St. Elizabeth Ann Seton Church in Shrub Oak. Campers bring lunch.
refund_policy_summary: 90% refund on requests by May 29, 50% from June 1 until camp starts, none once camp begins; $20 processing fee.

sessions.name: Full Day Camp, grades 1 to 5, Crompond Elementary (non-resident)
Half Day Camp, grades K to 5, Shrub Oak (non-resident)

notes: Non-resident prices are the brochure's fees plus its stated 20% non-resident surcharge: full day $1,428, half day $822 for the season. Residents pay $1,190 and $685 (less for siblings). Non-residents can register from April 21 only if room remains. The town also runs a Travel Camp for grades 6 to 9 (not in this listing). The brochure posts resident fees only; non-residents add 20%.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Day Camp Information page: 'Thank you for a fun summer camp season! Check back in January for information on the 2027 summer day camp season.' Links the Spring & Summer 2026 brochure.

Researched by Claude from this page. Spring & Summer 2026 brochure (PDF), pages 2 and 20: registration March 17 for town and school district residents; non-residents from April 21 if room, with a 20% surcharge on listed fees. Half Day Camp K to 5, 8:30 to 12, June 30 to July 31 (no camp July 3), St Elizabeth Ann Seton Church, 1377 E Main St, Shrub Oak, $685 first child. Full Day Camp grades 1 to 5, 8:30 to 3, same dates, Crompond Elementary School, 2901 Manor St, Yorktown Heights, NY 10598 (a second site TBD), $1,190 first child; free swim at Shrub Oak Park or Junior Lake Pool; lunch is the camper's responsibility. Extended Day 3 to 6 pm for full day campers, $555. Refund policy page 2. Session prices are the listed first child fee plus the 20% non-resident surcharge ($1,190 x 1.2 = $1,428; $685 x 1.2 = $822), worked out by Claude, not printed. Ages derived from grades.
